head.note: it never enters `features`, `history` or a pixel region; it only adds gradient to the shared GRU while training

auxiliary.note: the closed loop runs the unmodified parent class; the auxiliary head is not constructed here at all

behaviour.note: candidates are the frozen horizontal six-class domain; actions are px/frame/2 in {-2,-1,0,1,2}; a constant run is "single_candidate" (one distinct candidate over all 80 decisions) and a two-segment run is "switches<=1" (at most one change); both are counted, listed and reported, never dropped
